Note.title: Note
Note.description: A cognitive note created by the user with title, time/schedule, preparation time, visual diagnosis, anomaly note, mediaId, icon, color, and creation timestamp.

baslik.description: Short action title for the note card

zaman.description: Human-readable time or reminder schedule expression

tarih_iso.description: ISO-8601 formatted datetime string or null

hazirlik_iso.description: ISO-8601 formatted preparation datetime string or null

teshis_notu.description: Visual diagnosis note or OCR excerpt

anomali_notu.description: Anomaly detection warning or pattern note

ikon.description: Emoji icon representing the category or type of note

renk.description: Pastel hex color string for the card background

calendar_event_id.description: Google Calendar event ID if synced with Google Calendar
